phases.title: Application, lock and disclosures
phases.summary: LO, Lock Desk and Disclosures dependencies remain distinct. Their source systems and permissions are not connected by this catalog.

steps.title: Application with the borrower
steps.action: Work with the borrower to complete the application.
steps.prerequisite: Borrower elects to proceed with the authorized application process.
steps.evidence: Authoritative application reference and observed date; a Hub task is not an LOS application event.

phases.title: MLP preparation and follow-up
phases.summary: Welcome, document collection and appraisal coordination can overlap. Source prerequisites differ; display order does not enforce a universal sequence.

steps.title: Welcome and contact preferences
steps.action: Introduce the team, discuss the next items, and record contact preferences, travel constraints and actual welcome outcome. Record the LP task/Custom Fields completion and notes only after the action.
steps.prerequisite: The MLP lane diagram starts after disclosures are sent and the LP task is assigned. The overall loan-flow diagrams place welcome alongside initial Processing after an STP request; confirm the actual trigger.
steps.evidence: Contact outcome, preferred channel, welcome date, recap reference and LP entry reference.

sources.locator: Welcome Call: disclosure/task trigger, call and LP completion nodes

steps.boundary: Record the actual human action and source reference. The Hub does not send, place orders, or update external records.

steps.title: Initial needs and wet-sign items
steps.action: Retrieve the source wet-sign items, review the needs list and prepare the borrower communication.
steps.prerequisite: Authorized needs list and applicable source forms supplied by the responsible team.
steps.evidence: Needs-list revision, requested-item references, actual contact/delivery outcome and next action.

sources.locator: Welcome Call: pull wet signs, email needs and wet signs

steps.boundary: The source term wet signs needs operational definition. No form is issued or message sent by a saved Hub task.

steps.title: Collect and review requested items
steps.action: Follow up on borrower and assigned third-party items; check completeness and legibility, record intended vesting, and route discrepancies. Insurance, title/escrow, payoff, authorization, LOE/CEL and VOR/WVOE requests remain human work.
steps.prerequisite: Reviewer-authored needs or a named request; requested items and applicable source access are known.
steps.evidence: Requested/received/reviewed references, page or legibility issues, actual delivery outcome, next owner and source revision.

sources.locator: Welcome Call: final follow-up; Processing: needs list and intended vesting

steps.boundary: No training thresholds, mortgagee wording, payoff duration or signature requirement becomes an automated rule. Human follow-up does not clear a condition.

reviewPoints.title: Loan status is not work completion
reviewPoints.detail: Approved, Suspended, CTC, Closed and Funded are source observations. They never replace Hub work statuses or authorize AI approval, denial, clearance, external writes or automatic step completion.

sources.locator: Approved and Clear to Close triggers

reviewPoints.title: Confirm the welcome trigger
reviewPoints.detail: The MLP lane starts after disclosures are sent/task assigned; the end-to-end view shows welcome beside initial Processing after STP. Preserve the actual trigger instead of enforcing one universal order.

sources.locator: Processing: parallel welcome and initial review

reviewPoints.title: Confirm appraisal ordering ownership
reviewPoints.detail: Detailed diagrams and training assign appraisal ordering to Processor; the communication overview also names MLP. Record requester, accountable owner and actual actor. MLP coordination must not create automatic orders.

reviewPoints.title: Route pricing and structure decisions explicitly
reviewPoints.detail: LO owns the diagram pricing call. Training assigns pricing/restructure to LO in one place and MLP in another. MLP records concerns and routes them to LO/Lock Desk; do not adopt credit or pricing authority from that conflict.

reviewPoints.title: Resolve suspense follow-up timing
reviewPoints.detail: The diagram assigns LO a 48–72-hour update; training p. 117 assigns MLP a response, while p. 118 assigns LO next-business-day escalation. Resolve both owner and timing; no accepted timer, calendar or exception policy is established.

reviewPoints.title: Keep CD events distinct
reviewPoints.detail: CD request, Initial CD issuance, signed-CD evidence, Final CD review and delivery/receipt are separate observations. Lock audit and Initial CD appear as parallel branches. No compliance deadline or universal loan gate is inferred.

sources.locator: CD request fork: Lock audit and Closing Initial CD
Clear to Close: signed CDs and Final CD review

reviewPoints.title: Processor scope remains with Cadre
reviewPoints.detail: Processor review, investor submission, suspense resolution, substantive appraisal review and source-status updates are dependencies. The user will supply processor detail later. The catalog is not a second processing engine and does not establish current Cadre capability.

reviewPoints.title: External parties are dependencies
reviewPoints.detail: Disclosures Desk, Investor, Title/notary and borrower are source roles, not automatically provisioned Hub accounts. Blend, IDS and the source Hub board are unverified interface labels. A suggested work template does not transfer the named role authority.

sources.locator: Blend, Hub board and IDS nodes

reviewPoints.title: Cropped sources do not supply complete rules
reviewPoints.detail: The origination image ends inside Processing; the middle image clips neighboring phases. Training embeds partial form/checklist views and unavailable videos. Missing branches, full schemas and current policies are not reconstructed.

reviewPoints.title: Training is not a lending-rule engine
reviewPoints.detail: Conflicting application-element lists, an inconsistent calendar example and unverified program/disclosure statements remain inactive references. No thresholds, qualification verdict, HPML/ROV clock or earliest-signing calculator is imported.

reviewPoints.title: Prove outcomes with source joins
reviewPoints.detail: Track human contact, document, handoff and revision evidence separately from elapsed waits and self-reported handling time. The training names locks, fundings, pull-through and turnaround; proving LIA impact still requires verified LIA touchpoints joined to authoritative LOS application/funding events and a comparable baseline. Signed, Closed, funded and later investor purchase remain distinct.

reviewPoints.title: Processor timing and recipient conflicts
reviewPoints.detail: The supplied training differs on disclosure timing, request recipients and the date used for first-payment planning. Dates and recipient selection remain human-reviewed; the Hub does not calculate legal deadlines.

reviewPoints.title: Source calculations need controlled originals
reviewPoints.detail: Several source examples contain inconsistent periods, units or formulas, and the income workbooks are not included. No source calculation, eligibility threshold or signature requirement is imported as executable logic.

reviewPoints.title: Preserve forms without implying execution
reviewPoints.detail: Source questions, list order and disclaimers remain distinct from added Hub coordination fields. Borrower certifications, investor decisions, document issuance and funding are controlled external actions.

cadences.title: Initial processor review: 24–48 hours
cadences.description: Unconfirmed diagram target. Start/stop, calendar, exceptions and responsible-owner acceptance are not defined; no timer is created.

cadences.title: Suspense client update: 48–72 hours
cadences.description: Unconfirmed source target for the LO update; training also has next-business-day escalation language. Record a human target and resolve the conflict before enforcement.

cadences.title: Welcome: within 24 hours of disclosure
cadences.description: Source operational target only. It does not establish a regulatory deadline, accepted SLA or automatic task start.

cadences.title: Requested borrower items: three-day expectation
cadences.description: Source conversation target, subject to contact preferences, travel and actual circumstances. Record an agreed human target; no automatic due date is computed.

cadences.title: Friday borrower check-in
cadences.description: Training calls for a weekly Friday update even when nothing changed. This is a manual planning reference, not a configured recurring message or task.

cadences.title: Email recap after a call or text
cadences.description: Training asks for a recap of next steps or requested items. Prepare and review the draft through the authorized human workflow; nothing is sent automatically.

note: Version 3 removes the Lead and discovery reference phase. The Hub is an operations platform; origination conversations are recorded outside it or as custom work on an existing loan.
